series.name: SUN2000-(100KTL, 110KTL, 115KTL)-M2 / (50K, 75K, 80K, 150K)-MG panel indicator status (PV / grid / comms / alarm-maintenance)
series.notes: C&I/utility panel LED table, distinct from the residential LED tables in SERIES 2 and SERIES 4. M2 and MG share the same 4-indicator scheme; the MG manual wording differs slightly ('is generated' vs 'was generated', and 'Off' has no meaning text for PV). Table key: Blinking Fast = on 0.2s/off 0.2s, Blinking Slowly = on 1s/off 1s. Codes are LED state strings, not numeric alarm IDs. NOTE: neither the MG nor the MC0 manual contains a numeric alarm table - both point to a separate 'Inverter Alarm Reference' document (see NEGATIVE), so this table is the only in-manual diagnostic content for those models.

codes.code: PV connection indicator Blinking green fast
aliases: PV connection indicator Blinking green fast

title.ur: DC environmental fault (PV side ka masla)

meaning.en: PV connection LED blinking fast green, with the alarm/maintenance LED red, indicates an environmental fault on the DC side.
meaning.ur: PV connection LED fast green blink aur alarm/maintenance LED red ka matlab DC side ka environmental fault hai.

causes.en: Environmental fault at the DC side: string voltage, polarity, isolation or AFCI related.
causes.ur: DC side ka environmental fault: string voltage, polarity, isolation ya AFCI se related.

causes.en: Combos/whitesmoke, soiling or debris on the module glass reducing string voltage.
causes.ur: Module glass par combos/whitesmoke, ghisav ya mairaaj girane se string voltage kam hota hai.

solutions.en: Open the app and read the DC-environmental alarm; the manual says to troubleshoot DC faults there as instructed by the app.
solutions.ur: App kholein ke DC-environmental alarm padhein; manual ke mutabiq wahi app ke mutabiq troubleshooting karein.

solutions.en: Measure per-string Voc and current with a clamp meter in full sun and compare the MPPT strings against each other.
solutions.ur: Poori dhoop mein clamp meter se har string ka Voc aur current measure karke MPPT strings ka aapas comparison karein.

solutions.en: Clean modules and check string fuses/combiner before suspecting the inverter; DC environmental faults are usually external.
solutions.ur: Inverter par shak karne se pehle modules saaf karein aur string fuses/combiner check karein; DC environmental faults aam tor par bahari hote hain.

codes.blinkPattern: PV connection indicator blinking green fast (on 0.2s, off 0.2s)

source.title: SUN2000-(100KTL, 110KTL, 115KTL)-M2 User Manual, Issue 13 (2024-01-12), Section 2.4.2 Indicator Status

title.ur: DC internal fault (inverter ki andar ki kharabi)

meaning.en: PV connection LED solid red with the alarm/maintenance LED red indicates an internal fault on the DC side of the inverter.
meaning.ur: PV connection LED solid red aur alarm/maintenance LED red ka matlab inverter ke DC side ka internal fault hai.

causes.en: Internal DC-side circuit fault inside the inverter (PV connection LED preferentially shows environmental faults, so solid red means internal).
causes.ur: Inverter ke andar DC side ka internal circuit fault (PV connection LED pehle environmental faults dikhata hai, is liye solid red ka matlab internal hai).

causes.en: The DC switches may already have auto-tripped on that internal fault, so the strings read as dead and the fault is misdiagnosed as a string problem.
causes.ur: Us internal fault par DC switches khud trip ho chuke ho sakte hain, is liye strings dead nazar aati hain aur fault string ka masla samajh liya jata hai.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm in the app before touching the DC side - this red state is an internal fault, not a wiring fault.
solutions.ur: DC side chhune se pehle app par numeric alarm padhein - yeh red state internal fault hai, wiring fault nahi.

solutions.en: Power off per the manual: AC switch, then all DC switches; this model needs 15 minutes to discharge to a safe voltage.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq band karein: AC switch, phir saare DC switches; is model ko safe voltage tak discharge hone mein 15 minute lagte hain.

solutions.en: If the internal fault persists after a documented restart, raise a case with the alarm ID - internal DC faults are not field-repairable.
solutions.ur: Documented restart ke baad bhi internal fault bana rahe to alarm ID ke saath case raise karein - internal DC faults field par repair nahi hote.

source.title: SUN2000-(100KTL, 110KTL, 115KTL)-M2 User Manual, Issue 13 (2024-01-12), Section 2.4.2 Indicator Status

codes.code: Grid connection indicator Blinking green fast
aliases: Grid connection indicator Blinking green fast

meaning.en: Grid connection LED blinking fast green with the alarm/maintenance LED red indicates an environmental fault on the AC side.
meaning.ur: Grid connection LED fast green blink aur alarm/maintenance LED red ka matlab AC side ka environmental fault hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage, frequency or phase imbalance outside the allowed window.
causes.ur: Grid voltage, frequency ya phase imbalance allowed window se bahar hai.

causes.en: AC switch open or an upstream breaker has tripped.
causes.ur: AC switch khula hai ya upstream breaker trip ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and frequency at the AC terminals before assuming the inverter is faulty.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko faulty maan lene se pehle AC terminals par grid voltage aur frequency measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC switch and all upstream breakers, including whether the utility has an outage on that feeder.
solutions.ur: AC switch aur saare upstream breakers check karein, is baat par bhi ke us feeder par utility ka outage hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Read the numeric grid alarm in the app; persistent trips with healthy readings mean an internal problem.
solutions.ur: App par numeric grid alarm padhein; readings theek hone par bhi trips bana rahe to masla internal hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Grid connection indicator blinking green fast (on 0.2s, off 0.2s)

source.title: SUN2000-(100KTL, 110KTL, 115KTL)-M2 User Manual, Issue 13 (2024-01-12), Section 2.4.2 Indicator Status

meaning.en: Grid connection LED solid red with the alarm/maintenance LED red indicates an internal fault on the AC side of the inverter.
meaning.ur: Grid connection LED solid red aur alarm/maintenance LED red ka matlab inverter ke AC side ka internal fault hai.

causes.en: Internal AC-side circuit fault, e.g. relay, filter or current sensing failure.
causes.ur: AC side ka internal circuit fault, maslan relay, filter ya current sensing ki kharabi.

causes.en: Internal fault on the AC side of the solar inverter.
causes.ur: Solar inverter ke AC side ka internal fault.

solutions.en: Get the numeric alarm in the app first; this state is not an external grid problem.
solutions.ur: Pehle app par numeric alarm lein; yeh state external grid ka masla nahi hai.

solutions.en: Power off in the documented order and wait the full 15 minutes discharge time before opening the AC compartment.
solutions.ur: Documented order se band karke AC compartment kholne se pehle poori 15 minute discharge time ka intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If it returns, check the AC cable and lugs once for a burned joint, then escalate with the alarm ID.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to AC cable aur lugs ko jhilm se kharaab joint ke liye ek baar check karein, phir alarm ID ke saath escalate karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(100KTL, 110KTL, 115KTL)-M2 User Manual, Issue 13 (2024-01-12), Section 2.4.2 Indicator Status

meaning.en: The alarm/maintenance LED is solid red: a major alarm has been generated.
meaning.ur: Alarm/maintenance LED solid red: major alarm generate hua hai.

causes.en: A major alarm has been generated on the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter par major alarm generate hua hai.

causes.en: If the PV or grid connection indicator is blinking green fast, the manual directs you to troubleshoot DC or AC environmental faults in the app.
causes.ur: Agar PV ya grid connection indicator fast green blink kar raha hai to manual ke mutabiq app par DC ya AC environmental fault troubleshoot karein.

solutions.en: If the PV/grid LEDs are blinking green fast, follow the app's DC or AC environmental fault guidance.
solutions.ur: Agar PV/grid LEDs fast green blink kar rahe hain to app ka DC ya AC environmental fault guidance follow karein.

solutions.en: If neither PV nor grid LED is blinking green fast, the manual says to replace components or the inverter as instructed by the app.
solutions.ur: Agar na PV na grid LED fast green blink kar raha hai to manual ke mutabiq app ke instructions ke mutabiq components ya inverter replace karein.

solutions.en: Record the alarm ID and Cause ID from the app before any restart, as the app's instructions depend on them.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi restart se pehle app se alarm ID aur Cause ID note karein, kyunke app ke instructions inhi par based hote hain.

source.title: SUN2000-(100KTL, 110KTL, 115KTL)-M2 User Manual, Issue 13 (2024-01-12), Section 2.4.2 Indicator Status

title.ur: Minor alarm (production kam, unit chal raha hai)

meaning.en: The alarm/maintenance LED blinking red fast: a minor alarm has been generated.
meaning.ur: Alarm/maintenance LED fast red blink: minor alarm generate hua hai.

causes.en: A minor alarm has been generated; some components are faulty but the unit can still feed the grid.
causes.ur: Minor alarm generate hua hai; kuch components kharab hain lekin unit ab bhi grid mehenay de sakta hai.

causes.en: A component is degraded rather than failed - the manual's own definition of a minor alarm is a component fault that does not stop grid feeding, so the usual culprits are fan, sensor or filter degradation.
causes.ur: Component fail nahi balki degrade hua hai - manual ka apna minor alarm definition hai component fault jo grid mehenay nahi rokta, is liye aam culprits fan, sensor ya filter ki degradation hain.

solutions.en: Read the alarm in the app; minor alarms are exactly the ones that are safe to fix while the unit keeps running.
solutions.ur: App par alarm padhein; minor alarms wahi hain jinhein unit chalte hue theek kiya ja sakta hai.

solutions.en: Prioritise derating-type causes: fan degradation, high temperature, or partial shading on one MPPT.
solutions.ur: Derating wali wajuhain pehle dekhein: fan ki degradation, high temperature, ya ek MPPT par partial shading.

solutions.en: Do not ignore a minor alarm that keeps returning - it usually precedes a major one on this platform.
solutions.ur: Baar baar aane wala minor alarm ignore na karein - is platform par aam tor par iske baad major aata hai.

meaning.en: The alarm/maintenance LED blinking red slowly: a warning alarm has been generated, usually an output derate.
meaning.ur: Alarm/maintenance LED slow red blink: warning alarm generate hua hai, aam tor par output derate.

causes.en: A warning alarm has been generated; the unit works but output power is reduced by external factors.
causes.ur: Warning alarm generate hua hai; unit chalta hai lekin external factors se output power kam hai.

causes.en: Power limit or export limitation enabled by the utility or site settings.
causes.ur: Power limit ya export limitation utility ya site settings se on ki gayi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether an export/power limit has been enabled in the app or by the utility - this is the most common warning cause.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke app ya utility ne export/power limit on ki hai ya nahi - yeh sab se aam warning ki wajah hai.

solutions.en: Compare the actual output against the expected kW for the irradiance; a persistent gap points to soiling or shading.
solutions.ur: Actual output ko irradiance ke mutabiq expected kW se compare karein; persistent gap par soiling ya shading ka shak karein.

solutions.en: Verify the grid code settings match the local requirement; a wrong grid code silently derates the unit.
solutions.ur: Grid code settings local requirement se match karte hain ya nahi check karein; galat grid code unit ko chupke se derate kar deta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Alarm/Maintenance indicator blinking red slowly (on 1s, off 1s)

codes.code: Alarm/Maintenance indicator Blinking green slowly or steady green
aliases: Alarm/Maintenance indicator Blinking green slowly or steady green

title.ur: Local maintenance chal raha hai (USB/WLAN/Bluetooth session)

meaning.en: Steady green = local maintenance succeeded; blinking green = local maintenance failed; blinking green slowly = in local maintenance or shut down by command.
meaning.ur: Steady green = local maintenance successful; blinking green = local maintenance fail; slow green blink = local maintenance mein ya command se shutdown.

causes.en: A USB flash drive, WLAN module, Bluetooth module or USB data cable is inserted into the USB port for local maintenance.
causes.ur: Local maintenance ke liye USB port mein USB flash drive, WLAN module, Bluetooth module ya USB data cable lagaya gaya hai.

solutions.en: If the LED blinks green slowly, the maintenance session is still running - wait for it to finish before pulling the device.
solutions.ur: Agar LED slow green blink kare to maintenance session chal raha hai - device nikalne se pehle uska intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If the LED blinks green fast, the operation failed; remove the USB device and retry, checking that the upgrade package was not modified.
solutions.ur: Agar LED fast green blink kare to operation fail hua; USB device nikaal ke dohra karein aur check karein ke upgrade package modify nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: After removing the device, the indicator shows the true alarm state - the manual warns maintenance state is shown first.
solutions.ur: Device nikalne ke baad indicator asal alarm state dikhata hai - manual warn karta hai ke pehle maintenance state dikhta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Alarm/Maintenance indicator steady green, or blinking green fast (failed), or blinking green slowly (in maintenance)

title.ur: Saare PV strings se disconnect hai

meaning.en: PV connection LED off: the inverter is disconnected from all PV strings, or the DC input voltage of all MPPT circuits is below 200 V.
meaning.ur: PV connection LED off: inverter saare PV strings se disconnect hai, ya saare MPPT circuits ka DC input voltage 200 V se kam hai.

causes.en: All DC switches off, or all MPPT inputs below the 200 V minimum.
causes.ur: Saare DC switches off, ya saare MPPT inputs 200 V minimum se neeche hain.
Raat mein PV generation nahi ho rahi.

solutions.en: At night this is normal; re-check after sunrise.
solutions.ur: Raat mein yeh normal hai; sunrise ke baad dobara check karein.

solutions.en: In daylight, measure the DC bus at the PV terminals with a 1100 V-rated meter; below 200 V points to an open string circuit.
solutions.ur: Din mein 1100 V rated meter se PV terminals par DC bus measure karein; 200 V se kam hai to open string circuit ki nishani hai.

solutions.en: Check every DC switch position and string fuse; the MC0 manual notes DC switches can auto-trip on an internal fault.
solutions.ur: Har DC switch ki position aur string fuse check karein; MC0 manual ke mutabiq DC switches internal fault par khud trip kar sakte hain.
